comments.body:
REAL REVIEW-RUN EVIDENCE + one AC I am correcting on the evidence rather than reporting as met.

Committed artifact: docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md (in this change, so it is repo-verifiable). Five real runs, all 'rebar review-plan --source local --no-sign' against ticket 4b14-8eae-404c-4b16, whose Scope says verbatim 'I went through the tree with grep and these are the files that mention it' and then lists 2 of the 6 files carrying the symbol.

WHAT IS PROVEN LIVE. The criterion fires reliably and correctly: 4/4 agent-tier runs produced a finding at validity 1.0 naming the omitted files, INCLUDING tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py:90 - the monkeypatch.setattr string reference that find_referencing_symbols cannot resolve, i.e. the exact site class that broke epic 061c S1. Contrast case also holds: the same criterion against 061c S1 itself (7468, plan already remediated) fired NOTHING and the review returned PASS.

TWO DEFECTS THE RUNS EXPOSED IN MY OWN SPEC, both fixed:
1. exec: 1-TURN was wrong. At 1-TURN the criterion ran and emitted nothing even on a deliberately thin plan - a 1-TURN reviewer cannot search code, so it could not name an omitted site, and the rubric rightly forbids speculation. Promoted to exec: AGENT (it now cites real line numbers), and the rubric's 'the plan's own text says it grepped' branch was made independently sufficient.
2. The move was DEAD BY CONSTRUCTION. The same incomplete-inventory evidence also fires the BUILT-IN G1G2/G6/E4 criteria, which are BLOCKING, while this criterion must stay ADVISORY per AC. Pass-4's coachable union is blocking-first-then-advisory, so a move keyed only on the advisory project id competes last and is never offered - precisely the dead-move failure mode the plan-review gate flagged for the code-review routing. Fixed by widening applies_when to [project.symbol-reference-completeness, G1G2, G6]; it still does NOT fire for empty triggers, project.portability, or security/tests. My own held-out test had encoded the wrong contract ('fires only for this criterion'); corrected under revert-first discipline (narrowed config -> confirmed RED for the right reason -> re-applied -> GREEN).

THE AC I AM CORRECTING. AC5 asked for 'a REAL run whose output CONTAINS that move'. Across four agent-tier runs the coach never SELECTED it. That is not a misconfiguration and no further config can fix it: the overlay controls APPLICABILITY (deterministically proven in tests - offered for the criterion, G1G2 and G6; 1 of 14 applicable moves in run 5's real trigger set; correctly not offered otherwise), while the coach LLM controls SELECTION and consistently preferred built-in moves. There is no closed enum on move_id, so a project move is structurally pickable - it simply was not picked. So the honest statement of what this story delivers is: detection demonstrated live and reliably; coaching demonstrated as OFFERED deterministically, with its appearance in any single run being a model judgement the overlay cannot guarantee. I am recording that rather than claiming AC5 as written.

AC ALREADY MET AND UNCHANGED: code-review moves were ALREADY overlay-driven (code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reads .rebar/code_review_moves.json) so no engine wiring was added; the criterion routes to plan_review only, and the ticket records why not code_review; posture is advisory via default_posture with no inert blocking_enabled key; a test proves the criterion id appears nowhere under src/rebar/; and a further test proves all three overlay assets are TRACKED (.rebar/prompts/* is ignored with per-file negations, so the new rubric was initially invisible to git and would have shipped to nobody).

comments.body:
AC5 FOLLOW-UP after two further real runs (6 and 7), which closed off the last available route. This is offered as evidence for a re-verification, not as a claim that AC5 as written is met.

Run 6: the demo plan's inventory was made COMPLETE - all six files that carry the symbol, verified by git grep (src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py, src/rebar/llm/runner.py, tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py, docs/code-navigation.md, docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md) - while the Scope still says verbatim 'I went through the tree with grep'. Result: verdict PASS, 0 blocking findings, and this criterion correctly emitted NOTHING.

Run 7: repeated after I fixed a genuine contradiction I had introduced in the rubric (the non-findings section said a complete inventory is never a finding, which silently overrode the stated-method branch; it is now scoped to SILENCE about method only). Same result: PASS, criterion silent.

So there is no plan shape that fires this criterion without also firing a BLOCKING built-in:
- inventory incomplete -> the criterion fires at validity 1.0, but G1G2/G6/E4 fire on the same evidence and BLOCK; Pass-4 coaches blocking findings first, so the advisory move loses selection (runs 3, 4, 5);
- inventory complete -> the criterion correctly abstains (runs 6, 7). A reviewer declining to flag a demonstrably complete inventory is behaving correctly.

I stopped here deliberately. Tuning the rubric further until it manufactures a finding purely to produce the demonstration would be gaming the oracle rather than testing it.

WHAT THIS SAYS ABOUT THE STORY'S PREMISE, which is the useful output of the investigation: the DETECTION half of this criterion is largely redundant with rebar's shipped built-ins. G1G2, G6 and E4 already catch an incomplete symbol inventory, at agent tier, citing real line numbers, and they catch it as BLOCKING - which is strictly stronger than this criterion's deliberately advisory posture. In run 5 a built-in even named the monkeypatch.setattr string-literal site itself. What is genuinely distinctive here is the METHOD coaching ('re-derive with find_referencing_symbols, then grep for the name as a string'), and that is exactly the part that cannot reliably reach an agent, because it travels through LLM coach selection rather than through configuration.

Everything shipped and landed: change 1024 is MERGED (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Full run log and this reasoning are committed in docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md so the conclusion is re-checkable without re-running anything.

A judgement call remains that I do not think an agent should make unilaterally: accept AC5 as amended (detection demonstrated live; coaching demonstrated as offered), OR drop this corrective half of the epic in favour of the built-ins that already block on the same evidence, OR pursue a non-overlay mechanism for the method coaching. I am leaving this ticket in_progress for that decision rather than forcing the close.

# B — Project-only coaching move: direct the agent to Serena when source references are missed

## Context / Problem

A reminder at grep-time (story A) is preventive. This story adds the **corrective** half: when a review actually
finds that source-code references were enumerated by hand or incompletely, the agent should be coached to
re-derive them with Serena. This is the same failure that produced three under-enumerated Scope sections in epic
`061c` (the epic itself, S1 naming two of three patch sites, S2 naming two of four affected test files).

## Verified ground truth (probed 2026-07-29; resolves the plan's "known unknown")

The original plan left "are code-review coaching moves overlay-driven?" open and made scope contingent on it.
It is resolved, and the answer changes the routing decision:

1. **Code-review moves ARE already overlay-driven.** `src/rebar/llm/code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry`
   (lines 86-103) merges project extensions from **`.rebar/code_review_moves.json`** — a *different* file from
   `.rebar/plan_review_moves.json`. So **no engine wiring is needed**, and the contingent
   `src/rebar/llm/...` scope item is dropped.
2. **But a `project.*` criterion id can never fire a code-review move.** Code-review `applies_when` tags are
   drawn from the **closed** `{OVERLAY_IDS ∪ "always"}` vocabulary (`code_review/moves.py:1-9`, 58-60), and the
   gate's `active_triggers` is the union of the surviving findings' *overlay* `criteria`
   (`code_review/workflow_ops.py::code_review_coach_inputs`). A move keyed
   `applies_when: ["project.symbol-reference-completeness"]` would register and then never be offered — a
   permanently dead move.
3. **Plan-review has no such restriction.** `plan_review/passes.py:765` builds `triggers` as the union of
   `criteria` carried by blocking + surviving findings, which *does* include project criterion ids — the
   existing `project.portability` / `project-portability` pair proves the path end-to-end.

**Decision, therefore: route the criterion to `plan_review` only.** That also matches the concern's own shape —
"the file/symbol inventory in this plan was enumerated by hand and is incomplete" is a plan-review judgement.

## Approach

Follow the existing `project.portability` pattern exactly, which is three files:

- `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` — a new criterion `project.symbol-reference-completeness` under `plan_review`,
  with `default_posture: "advisory"` (and NO `blocking_enabled` — that field is a code-review-only
  convention which plan-review's `threshold_for` never reads (`src/rebar/llm/criteria/model.py:73-76`), so
  including it would be inert and misleading; `project.portability` carries no such field), plus its `activate`
  entry `["plan_review"]`.
- `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-symbol-reference-completeness.md` — the criterion's reviewer prompt:
  detect a plan whose affected-file / call-site inventory was enumerated by hand (or is demonstrably
  incomplete) rather than derived from the symbol graph.
- `.rebar/plan_review_moves.json` — the matching move `applies_when: ["project.symbol-reference-completeness"]`,
  whose template directs re-derivation with `find_referencing_symbols` **and** the string-literal sweep
  (`monkeypatch.setattr` / `getattr` / `importlib`) the LSP cannot resolve, so the coaching is complete rather
  than half-right.

**Posture: advisory, never blocking.** This coaches a method, not a correctness property; blocking on "how did
you find these references" would gate process and fire noisily.

## Scope

- `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` — the new `project.*` criterion + its `activate` entry (plan_review only).
- `.rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-symbol-reference-completeness.md` — the criterion prompt.
- `.rebar/plan_review_moves.json` — the matching move.
- No `src/rebar/` change: the overlay machinery already exists (ground truth 1), so shipped defaults for other
  clients are untouched by construction.

## Testing

- A test asserts the overlay files are valid and self-consistent: the criterion id appears under `plan_review`,
  its `activate` list is exactly `["plan_review"]`, its posture is `default_posture: "advisory"` with no
  inert `blocking_enabled` key, a
  prompt file exists at the conventional path, and the move's `applies_when` names the criterion id (a move
  keyed on an id no criterion emits is dead — the failure mode ground truth 2 identified).
- A test asserts the criterion id appears nowhere under `src/rebar/` (shipped defaults unchanged for other
  clients).
- **Real run:** a `rebar review-plan` against a ticket whose inventory was hand-enumerated emits the move; the
  output is attached to this ticket as a comment.
- **Contrast:** a review of a ticket with a symbol-derived inventory does not emit it (recorded, not asserted in
  a unit test — LLM output is not deterministic enough to gate CI on).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] a project-only criterion + coaching move exists whose move text directs re-deriving source references with
      Serena's symbol tools, INCLUDING the string-literal (`monkeypatch.setattr`/`getattr`) sweep the LSP cannot do
- [ ] the criterion is advisory via `default_posture: "advisory"` — the only field plan-review's
      `threshold_for` reads — and carries NO `blocking_enabled` key (code-review-only, inert here)
- [ ] the criterion routes to `plan_review` only, and the ticket records WHY not `code_review` (a `project.*` id
      can never enter code-review's closed `applies_when` vocabulary, so such a move would be dead)
- [ ] it is recorded on the ticket that code-review coaching moves were ALREADY overlay-driven
      (`code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry` reads `.rebar/code_review_moves.json`), so no wiring was added
- [ ] a REAL `rebar review-plan` run emits the move, with the output attached as a comment on this ticket (not a
      unit-test-only demonstration)
- [ ] the criterion rides the `.rebar/` overlay only: a test proves the criterion id appears nowhere under
      `src/rebar/`, so the shipped default criteria set is unchanged for other rebar clients
- [ ] the contrast case is recorded: a review of a ticket with a symbol-derived inventory does not emit the move
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `make test` pass
